comment: The six steps scene_matrix.py enters from the title and that leave at once for want of state (91 93 94 115 117 118, DEBUG-TOOLS.md section 2).  Each is seeded from a RAM capture taken where the game itself called goto_step(N) in a checkpoint segment: the game-state block a card carries (restore_block) and the scene scratch block the card does not carry (0x8012B1B0..CF: Tkind work_tarao, Twhose event_girl_no, serifu_no, the battle id rpg_bat_arg, serifu_state; KONAMI-DEBUG-FACILITIES.md section 6) plus date_disp_flag (date_event_sched's return flag).  The base is the same checkpoint card, so the album the capture's run loaded is already in place.

cap093_geko.note: a GEKO character event (93): the first of the candidate segments whose week has one

cap115_rensyu.note: the baseball practice match (RENSYU 115) via the holiday club icon
